name: pos-realtime-worker
description: Per-cafe Cloudflare Worker: one hibernatable Durable Object room (cafe:<TENANT_ID>) fanning HMAC-authenticated write events out to the cafe's devices. CLIENT-OWNED (one deployment per cafe, in the client's own account) — contrast the vendor-owned workers/failover. A supplement to the cafe's polls, never a replacement. NOT part of any Next build; outside the npm workspace.
